definitions.empty: exactly one quoted name:t whose value is exactly the empty string; no trimming
definitions.mixed: a node's direct ent children include both explicit-empty and explicit-nonempty and no unknown name
definitions.all_empty: every direct ent child has an explicit-empty name; no topology/runtime inference
definitions.unknown: missing, duplicate, wrong-type or nonliteral name; never silently classified as explicitly empty
definitions.dag4blend_default: separate model-derived counts: omitted name defaults to empty in actual cmp_ent; explicit-empty and missing-name source counts retained separately; wrong-type/nonliteral/duplicate remain unknown

limitations: comment/string-aware structural declaration scanner, not complete BLK syntax validation
counts are source facts, not MH/Dagor import-success counts
no include expansion or effective type/runtime semantics
file sets overlap; do not sum file counts across categories
per-file stability checks are not a global atomic filesystem snapshot
